resources.string: %1$s presents a different self-signed certificate than the one you trusted. If you didn\'t replace it, someone may be pretending to be your server.
Every song but the one playing is removed from the queue.
This will stop the player and close the fullscreen player
The next certificate %1$s presents will be trusted without asking.
The songs go back to the album\'s own order.
Playback stops and the app opens again, settings that need a restart apply then.
Playback stops for a moment, then goes on where it was with the new settings.
The sleep timer is on, it stops with the player.
It will be moved to your downloads and kept on this device until you delete it.
The cached copy is worse than the quality set now, so the song will be downloaded again.
%1$s will be removed from this device. It can still be streamed.
Every profile, setting and the library are replaced with the backup\'s, then the app restarts. Passwords and sign ins of profiles in the backup that are on this device are kept.
Every song this profile played is taken out of its history.
Only the plays matching your filters are removed. The rest of the history stays.
Every song this profile disliked shows up in its lists again.
Only the songs matching your filters show up in your lists again. The rest stay hidden.
Every song this profile downloaded is removed from this device. They can still be streamed.
The downloaded songs shown are removed from this device, the others stay. They can still be streamed.
Every image kept on this device is removed, they load again when shown.
Also clear images kept in memory
Every streamed song kept on this device is removed, for every profile. Downloads stay.
Every downloaded song is removed from this device, for every profile. They can still be streamed.
%1$s is stored, more than %2$s. Once the app restarts, what doesn\'t fit is removed, what was used least recently first.
%1$s is stored. Once the app restarts, all of it is removed and nothing new is kept.
Downloads take %1$s. None are deleted, but no new song can be downloaded.
Downloads take %1$s, more than %2$s. None are deleted, but new downloads are refused until there is room.
The saved username, password and API key are removed. You can sign in again any time.
Your %1$s library stops showing here, the songs you liked stay liked. You can sign in again any time.
